title: Deezer will soon let you filter out AI-generated music
key_facts: Deezer, a music streaming service, said on Tuesday (13 Oct 2026) it is working on a toggle that hides AI-generated music
The toggle is expected before the end of the year
Turning it on removes AI-generated tracks, albums and related artists from search results
Deezer CEO Alexis Lanternier cited user demand; a survey from last year found about 45% of customers wanted a way to remove AI music
In July, Deezer said more than 50% of daily uploads were AI-generated, about 90,000 tracks a day
Bandcamp banned AI tracks, Tidal cut off monetisation for AI uploads and Spotify only tags them
Variety reported in August that Apple Music planned to label AI tracks by year end
quote_evidence: The company on Tuesday said it is working on a new toggle that lets users filter out AI-generated music uploaded to its platform.
In July, the company said that more than 50% of daily uploads to its platform were AI-generated tracks, with an average of 90,000 tracks per day.
why_it_matters_hint: Listeners will be able to choose to hear only human-made music on Deezer.
notes: Read in full. Article dated 14 Oct; announcement on the Tuesday (13 Oct).
